own_solution.law: Lossless line step response: Z0 = sqrt(L/C), V+ = E Z0/(Z0+Rs), V_L = V+(1+Gamma_L)
assumptions: ideal step at t=0 on uncharged line

defect_reasons.other: T2129 ('cut to a length') could suggest the stated totals no longer apply; the answer is unaffected because Z0 depends only on L/C, which is per-length invariant.

notes: Agrees with pass 1. Checked: Rs+22 = 47 -> V+ = 500/97 = 5.155, V_L = 7.732 V; Rs+42 = 67 -> 6.410 V; Rs+65 = 90 -> 5.357 V; all match. Length cancellation correct. Minimal pairs TAB4E/T6BEA (42 ohm, lamp vs source) and T8F3D/TADD9 (42 ohm, earlier test vs before switch-on) hold; numeral-free twins consistent.
